paymentHelp.a: Contributions are collected by TurnByTurn's payment partner (Squadco) and held until the whole cycle is paid. They are never sent to the group organiser directly.
TurnByTurn adds a 2% fee on top of each contribution you pay. It is never deducted from anyone's payout.
Yes. Choose "Pay part", enter an amount, and pay the rest any time before the due date. Each part payment has its own receipt.

paymentHelp.q: I paid but it still shows unpaid.
paymentHelp.a: Bank confirmations can take a few minutes. Pull to refresh. If it still shows unpaid after 30 minutes, contact support with your payment reference (it starts with TRX-).

paymentHelp.q: I was charged more than I owed.
paymentHelp.a: Your original payment record is kept exactly as received. Open the payment and tap "Submit for review"; our team will refund or credit the excess.

paymentHelp.q: Why is the payout on hold?
paymentHelp.a: A payout is released only after every member has paid for the cycle. The Cycle Progress screen shows who still owes.
Your money is safe. Failed transfers are retried by our team; you will see the status change to "Delayed recovery" and then "Sent".

paymentHelp.q: Can the amount or turn order change?
paymentHelp.a: No. Amount and turn order are locked once the group starts.
